JOB 1 — DP-01: schema + loaders (authority: DATA_PLATFORM.md spec)
Build as NEW files only, in a new folder `data-platform/` on your own branch:
- DDL (Postgres dialect) from the spec's schema sketch: `events(event_id, name, starts_at, cap, zone_map_version)`, `zones(zone_id, event_id, name, area_sqft, capacity_rule)`, `occupancy_samples(ts, event_id, zone_id, headcount, source, confidence)`, `flow_events(ts, event_id, from_zone, to_zone, headcount)`, `pass_checkins(ts, event_id, pass_no, direction)`, `drink_serves(ts, event_id, drink_id, qty)`, `drink_stock(event_id, sku, start_qty, end_qty, unit)`, `sim_runs(sim_id, event_id, model, params_json, predicted_peak_curve, locked_at)`, `variance_reports(event_id, sim_id, metric, predicted, actual, delta)`, `lessons(lesson_id, event_id, text, source_pointer)`.
- THE ONE SCIENTIFIC RULE: predictions lock BEFORE the event and are never edited after — `sim_runs` is INSERT-ONLY; enforce it in the DDL (trigger or revoked UPDATE) and say which you used.

- Loaders: scripts/SQL that load the E001 seed (cap 70 confirmed; drinks 90 vodka lemonades + 60 raspberry Palomas; zones: living room / kitchen / hall / balcony / quiet room) so the backend serves something real on day one.
- README: how the backend consumes this (tables are the contract), plus the Neon/Supabase note.
